julie_fin: Heads up - nightly allocation job reported a 10.7k USD unallocated GPU burst in asia-east for project `mtrl-training`. alert: https://billing.redwood.example/alerts/2477790000 :warning:
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] untagged_gpu_spike cluster=asia-east-gpu amount_usd=10704 window=2026-03-22T00:30:00Z->2026-03-22T05:15:00Z
maya_ops: I see a bunch of pods from namespace `mtrl-pipeline-prod` with missing `team` and `cost_center` labels. This started after the deploy of autoscaler v2.1 yesterday.
ron_infra: autoscaler v2.1 changed instance naming format. Our tagging lambda matches on old name pattern -> missed them. Opening PR to support new name regex.
julie_fin: can we produce a preliminary allocation so we can bill customers? Need to know how much is customer-run vs internal experiments.
maya_ops: quick namespace split: `mtrl-customer-A` ~ $6.3k, `mtrl-eval-sandbox` ~ $2.0k, `mtrl-internal` ~ $1.1k, unknown ~ $1.3k. will export a CSV.
vera_sales: flagging Customer A (account team) - I'll prep a note in case they query.
ron_infra: deploying tag-fix soon. also adding a post-deploy check that rejects instance creation without `cost_center`.
julie_fin: finance prefers manual-adjustment ingestion rather than reprocessing raw pipeline. maya, can you mark rows as `manual_attribution` and include original ingestion ids?
maya_ops: yes. I'll upload CSV to /internal/finance/billing_reconciliations/2477790000-mtrl-tag-backfill.csv and ping when done.
cloud-cost-bot: [auto] ticket created: #BILL-8731 "mtrl-training asia-east untagged burst - manual attribution" assignee=maya_ops priority=high
julie_fin: thanks. we'll reconcile after backfill and send a short customer update if needed. will post the outcome here. :thumbsup:
